welcome.title: Congratulations on your move to Germany!
welcome.body: We'll help you settle in. Answer a few questions and get your personal plan for the first weeks.

onb.other.placeholder: Tell us in a few words

onb.consent.body: Your answers stay on this phone and build your plan.
onb.consent.optional: Optional. You can still use everything without it.
me.id: Your anonymous ID, for deletion requests:
timeline.empty: No verified tasks yet — content is being checked against official sources.
task.notFound: This task doesn't exist any more.

entitled.intro: Money, discounts, courses and free help — picked for your status. Tap a card for details.
entitled.otherIntro: These depend on another status or permit. If your situation changes, they may apply.
people.intro: Meet people who are new in {place} too — over coffee, a walk or a trip to the Bürgeramt.
people.mineNote: Only you can see these for now. They go live for others when People opens in your city.
people.emptyBody: Be the first: suggest a coffee, a walk or a language exchange. People like you will see it.
people.notify: Tell me when someone in {place} suggests a meetup
people.examplesNote: Examples to show how it works — not real meetups yet.
people.safety: Meet in public places. Only first names are shown — never your residence status.
meetup.title: Suggest a meetup
meetup.intro: People who are new in {place} will see it.
meetup.name: Title
meetup.namePh: e.g. Sunday walk along the river
meetup.wherePh: e.g. Café near the main station
meetup.whereNote: Public places only — never a home address. People who join see the exact spot.
meetup.rules: I'll meet in a public place and treat everyone with respect.
meetup.fakeNote: For now your meetup stays on this phone. We'll publish it when People opens in your city.
me.aboutNote: Shown only to people at meetups you join. A first name is enough — we never ask for your surname, birthday or passport number.
me.name: First name or nickname
me.aboutPh: e.g. New in town, love long walks and board games
me.situationNote: From your answers. This builds your plan and never appears on People.
me.datesNote: Private, on this phone. We remind you before they run out.
me.visaAdvice: Book your Ausländerbehörde appointment now — apply before the end date.
me.passportAdvice: Renew it at your embassy: your permit is tied to a valid passport.
me.notifyMeetups: Tell me when someone near me suggests a meetup
me.data1: Your answers, dates, ticks and meetups stay on this phone.
me.data2: Only if you agreed above: anonymous answers (purpose, status, state, arrival month) — no free text, no exact dates.
me.data3: Your name, interests, important dates and meetups are never sent anywhere.
me.deleteAsk: Delete everything on this phone? This can't be undone.
discover.intro: Optional and fun — tick what you tried, remove what's not for you.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Your plan and answers are safe on this phone. Reload to continue.
discover.empty: Nothing left here — restore removed ideas below.
cat.food.intro: Dishes and drinks to try — local and seasonal ones first.
cat.routines.intro: Small habits that make daily life in Germany easier.
cat.outdoors.intro: Getting outside and moving, the way locals do.
cat.traditions.intro: Customs and celebrations — holidays near you are listed above.
discover.personaliseHint: Tell us what you like — ideas will follow your taste.
discover.tripsNote: Regional trains — covered by the Deutschlandticket.

taste.intro: A few questions so Discover suggests what suits you. Skip anything you like.
taste.company: Who do you usually go with?
taste.private: Your answers stay on this phone. We never send what you eat or drink anywhere.
